games.name: Hit The Thrift [Alpha]
games.desc:
drop into the thrift and see what you can find. hunt through racks for rare pieces, clean them up at the laundromat, and resell for profit.

- talk to craig to find out what items he wants.
- search the thrift store for clothes that match his request, then wash them at the laundromat.
- sell your freshly cleaned clothes to craig for profit and put together your own fits for aura.
